Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt

Class MqttHistoryStore

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mqtt.MqttHistoryStore
public final class MqttHistoryStore extends Object
The on-disk half of the MQTT message history: an append-only, line-per-entry file that survives restarts. Each line is a MqttHistoryEntry.encode() record, so the file is greppable and a damaged or hand-edited line is skipped rather than failing the whole load.

Writes are append-only (cheap per message); the file is trimmed to maxEntries() on load(), which is the one moment the whole file is already in memory. Every operation is best-effort with respect to I/O errors — history is a convenience, and a read-only home directory must never break the MQTT client itself, so failures are reported through lastError() instead of propagating.

    • load

      public List<MqttHistoryEntry> load()
      Reads the persisted entries oldest-first, keeping at most maxEntries() of the newest, and rewrites the file when it had grown past that cap. Unreadable lines are skipped; a missing file simply yields an empty list.
